question: Can a method-independent, PaiNN-native index-one saddle set be constructed from Transition1x endpoint labels?
hypothesis: A subset of relaxed T1x endpoint pairs will yield short PaiNN NEB paths whose maximum image is stationary enough and has one projected negative mode.
decision_rule: A candidate is accepted only when both PaiNN endpoint relaxations converge at fmax <= 0.02 eV/A, the PaiNN NEB converges at fmax <= 0.05 eV/A, the maximum image has fmax <= 0.05 eV/A, and the full mass-weighted Eckart-projected Hessian has n_neg = 1. Candidate inclusion does not depend on GAD or Sella.

backend.name: neuralneb-painn
backend.reference_builder: PaiNN endpoint BFGS plus seven-image climbing NEB

resources.allocation: one A100 3g.20gb MIG slice, 4 CPU cores, 20G memory, 45 minutes

implementation_history.65759953: Failed at startup: ASE 3.29 does not re-export NEBOptimizer from ase.mep; no chemistry ran.
implementation_history.65760844: Cancelled before execution after the attempted ase.neb compatibility import failed in local preflight.
implementation_history.65760845: Completed: three coarse PaiNN-native projected index-one candidates accepted from five examined test structures.

result.interpretation: Pipeline smoke passed at the predeclared 0.05 eV/A NEB threshold. These are not yet tight enough for the paired optimizer benchmark.

next_action: Build a separate tight PaiNN-native set with endpoint fmax <= 0.005 eV/A and NEB-max fmax <= 0.01 eV/A, then apply two-sided native endpoint validation before paired GAD/Sella perturbation searches.
